name: deep_memory_search
description: COMPREHENSIVE DEEP SEARCH across ALL Jarvis data sources. Use when normal search tools (search_memory, semantic_recall) return nothing or user needs to find EVERYTHING related to a topic. Searches: memory database (facts), terminal conversations, web UI conversations, intel folder files, canvas pages, and stash artifacts. Returns unified results with source labels. Use for: 'find everything about X', 'have I ever mentioned Y', 'search all my data for Z', or when user is certain info exists but quick searches miss it. SLOWER than single-source tools - use only when comprehensive search needed.

query.description: Search query - can be keywords, phrase, or natural language question

sources.description: Which sources to search. Default: ['all'] searches everything. Narrow to specific sources if you know where to look.

mode.description: Search mode. 'comprehensive' (default) uses both keyword and semantic for memory. 'keyword' is faster for exact matches. 'semantic' for meaning-based.

limit_per_source.description: Max results per source (default 5). Total results = sources × limit.

date_filter.description: Optional: 'today', 'week', 'month', 'year', or ISO date like '2024-01-01' for results after that date
